target_surface: BHP Warehouse Packing Tracker secondary Bol account support
problem: The runtime accepts only one Bol OAuth pair, while the requested scanner behavior must retain that account and include one additional client account.

nodes.label: retain existing Bol coverage and add client account
server/config.mjs
nodes.evidence: Current config requires one BOL_CLIENT_ID/BOL_CLIENT_SECRET pair

nodes.label: same-origin retailer and scan routes
nodes.evidence: server/application.mjs routes all reads and scans through one bolClient

nodes.label: browser complete snapshot
nodes.evidence: index.html fetches unqualified orders/shipments/details before enabling scan

nodes.label: live scan verification
nodes.evidence: server/scan-service.mjs reads shipment then order from one client

nodes.label: ampere package and event provenance
nodes.evidence: migration has tracking/order/shipment fields but no account key

nodes.label: numbered ampere migration runner
nodes.evidence: scripts/migrate.mjs currently reads only 001 and guards only CREATE statements

nodes.label: dual-account release proof
nodes.evidence: Project finish line requires tests plus desktop/mobile inspection

edges.evidence: A second account cannot authenticate without configuration
API constructs the configured Bol client
Browser reads /api/retailer before it permits scanning
Browser sends snapshot shipment identity to /api/scan
Scan service persists decision data through repository
Existing deployed tables need an additive migration rather than a changed CREATE TABLE
Credential availability and user-facing result require the exact released artifact

order_1: secondary credentials must be validated and selected server-side
order_2: combined pagination and scan verification retain account provenance
a numbered migration sequence can add provenance to already deployed ampere tables
database audit can distinguish source-qualified decisions while retaining null for unknown codes
order_3: complete combined snapshots prevent silent omission of client packages
fixed source keys avoid arbitrary account access
feedback_loops: A failed account list/detail/token call makes the combined snapshot unhealthy, which disables scanning until recovery.

verification_edges.verification: configuration and server tests reject partial pairs and expose no secret values
two-account browser fixtures prove merged complete data and source-qualified GO/STOP behavior
fresh and pre-002 local schemas each converge through an idempotent ampere-only migration sequence
local migration/repository tests and restricted production readback show only ampere provenance
exact deployment plus authenticated desktop/mobile visual receipt

decision: Use one explicit optional secondary pair and fixed internal source keys; do not replace the existing primary pair or create a general account registry.
